cohort: 84 extremely low-birthweight (ELBW) infants born between January 2008 and December 2013 at a single academic center who survived beyond 36 weeks of postmenstrual age
finding: The coexistence of maternal HCAM and perinatal Ureaplasma exposure was significantly associated with prolonged mechanical ventilation in ELBW infants.
mod_finding: While this study does not compare modes of delivery, it does note mode of delivery as a factor adjusted for in its analysis of prolonged mechanical ventilation in infants.
